oliver: Quick question — urgent care billed me as self-pay because they couldn't find my card. I only had the insurer app screenshot. I paid $76. What do I need to get reimbursed?

maya (People Ops): Sorry that happened. Short checklist: 1) itemized receipt with date, service line, total and provider name; 2) digital ID PDF from insurer portal (app screenshot sometimes accepted but PDF is better); 3) submit a member claim to the insurer and cc benefits@redwood.com.

oliver: The receipt is terse (just total and clinic name). They said they don't provide CPTs by default.

broker-lucy: Call the clinic billing and request an "itemized statement" or UB-04. Ask them for the billing NPI or Tax ID. If they refuse, attach the receipt plus your clinic check-in sign-in sheet or any visit note you have.

insurer-bot: Digital ID ready: https://portal.insurer/example-id-oliver.pdf :card_file_box: (valid through 2027-09-01)

maya (People Ops): Sample claim email you can send quickly:

To: claims@insurer.example
Subject: Member claim submission — urgent care 2026-12-14 — Member ID: 555222333

Body: Please find attached receipt for an urgent care visit on 2026-12-14 for Oliver R. Provider: Lakeshore Urgent Care. Member ID: 555222333, Group: RW-00011. Attachments: receipt.pdf, digital_id.pdf. Please advise processing timeline and reimbursement steps.

oliver: Sent it and cc'd benefits. If insurer processes as out-of-network, what's next?

maya (People Ops): If it's truly out-of-network, reimbursement will follow our plan's OON rules (balance billing possible). If provider was in-network but billed incorrectly, we'll open a provider-directory dispute and ask insurer to reprocess. Typical EOB timeline: 2-4 weeks. If denied, forward the EOB and we'll help file an appeal.

broker-lucy: If you want a physical card mailed, request it via the insurer portal > Account > Request Card. I can also request expedited mailing through our broker channel if needed.

oliver: Thanks — I'll request the itemized bill and the physical card if clinics keep asking. Appreciate the help.
